name: Wildmane Cleansing Totem
summary: At Mulgore’s Wildmane Water Well, one last cleansing remains. After the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells are cleansed, Mull Thunderhorn prepares a totem for the well north of Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Purifying the Sacred Wells
sections.body:
The Wildmane Water Well still needs cleansing. Goblin ventures have poisoned the land and fouled Mulgore’s scarce water. So the tauren turn to sacred ritual against the blight.

After the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells are cleansed, Mull Thunderhorn crafts a final totem for the well north of Thunder Bluff. Natural spirits fill it, and it purifies the fetid water so life can nourish the plains again.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Wildmane Cleansing Totem?
faq.answer: Tauren use the totem in a purification ritual at the Wildmane Water Well north of Thunder Bluff. It cleanses the poisons and foul runoff there.

faq.q: Who creates the Wildmane Cleansing Totem?
aliases: where do i get the cleansing totem
faq.answer: Mull Thunderhorn creates the totem after you gather the needed components and cleanse Mulgore’s other tainted wells.

faq.q: Why are the water wells in Mulgore poisoned?
faq.answer: Goblin ventures have brought poisons and industrial runoff into Mulgore’s water. These threaten the tauren tribes and the plains’ natural balance.

faq.q: Where does this totem need to be used?
aliases: where do i take the totem
faq.answer: Use the totem at the Wildmane Water Well north of Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a tauren, you restore the Wildmane well in duty to the Earth Mother. You protect your ancestral homeland from foreign industrial toxins.
As a shaman, you channel spiritual purification through carved totems. This helps mend water spirits wounded by reckless industry.
